symbol: # Synapse development and function gene panel for C. elegans (v6)
# Shown in the application as "Synapse development and function"; the table,
# search prefix and enrichment key keep the name synaptogenesis.
# References checked against Crossref; SYNAPTOGENESIS.txt in the
# transdaomic-pipeline repo records the per-gene verification status.
# - refs column: every gene cites at least one primary research article, by the
#   R ids in src/lib/synaptogenesis-references.ts. Inline citations left the
#   notes column. Class-level reviews stay on the class, not the gene.
# - Dropped daf-2, daf-7, daf-12 and daf-16 (tangential) and the dauer_signaling
#   subclass; class 02 no longer mentions dauer. Nolan 2002 and McGehee 2015 are
# - New class Synaptic cargo transport: unc-104, unc-116, klp-4, arl-8, cdk-5
#   and cyy-1 moved from the release machinery; klc-2, unc-16 and unc-108 added.
# - Classes renumbered into a developmental sequence: 01 activity-regulated TFs,
#   02 RNA export, 03 synapse positioning, 04 specificity / adhesion, 05 active
#   zone, 06 growth control, 07 cargo transport, 08 vesicle release, 09
#   remodeling. The numeric prefix is the only thing that changed in a class id.
# - crh-1 moved from RNA export to the activity-regulated TFs (CREB's canonical role is
#   transcriptional); slo-1 moved from remodeling to the presynaptic ion
#   channels of the release class (Wang 2001); calcium_channels renamed
#   synaptic_ion_channels (egl-19 acts postsynaptically in muscle); vesicle_transport_and_biogenesis_factors renamed
# - Added unc-41, unc-11, the AP2 complex (dpy-23/apm-2, apa-2, aps-2), unc-32,
#   unc-5, snf-11. unc-46 was already present.
# - ser-2 note corrected: it is a tyramine receptor, not serotonin/dopamine.
# v5 changes: the proneural / fate-specifying and terminal selector TF classes
# are dropped as upstream of synaptogenesis proper; the rest renumber 01-11.
# v4 changes: subclass is now the gene's role within its class, from a fixed
# list of 2-6 roles per class (labels in src/lib/synaptogenesis-references.ts).
# The former molecular tag moved to the family column, which the app ignores.
# wormbase_id keys each row; the build falls back to resolving symbol only
# when it is blank, so a substituted panel may arrive as names alone.
